dialogues.speaker: Rather Aged Notes
dialogues.text: (These notes seem to have been plundered during a recent raid on the Fatui. The age of these notes has made the words difficult to recognize.)

dialogues.speaker: Rather Aged Notes
dialogues.text: "...I dared to hide the remains of that melted nagamaki in the Arsenal together with Nozomu's artwork..."

dialogues.speaker: Rather Aged Notes
dialogues.text: "I wish that the Inspector will someday find it in his heart to remember the joy he felt when forging a weapon with his own hands, before Sir Katsuragi..."
